expected.finding: **[P1]** **Passwords in Python dictionary output reach public policy proposals.** [improvement_policy.py:120](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/improvement_policy.py:120) handles double-quoted JSON fields but misses `{'password': '[REDACTED]'}`. I reproduced this password surviving the miner’s report and JSON; five distinct failures then produced a revision containing it in `mined_from` and, lowercased, in the topic keywords. The workflow publishes these files automatically. Redact single-quoted credential fields before reporting or tokenizing, and add a regression covering the complete mining-to-proposal path.

diff --git a/scripts/improvement_policy.py b/scripts/improvement_policy.py
index 3d1dcc39..42ee025d 100644
--- a/scripts/improvement_policy.py
+++ b/scripts/improvement_policy.py
@@ -111,16 +111,22 @@ _SECRET_SHAPES: [REDACTED] ...] = (
         r"(?i)((?:--?[a-z0-9-]*(?:token|secret|password|passwd|api-?key|access-?key|private-?key|auth|key)\b|(?<!\S)-p)(?:\s+|=)?)"
         r"(\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*'|[^\s\"']{4,})"
     ),
-    # curl-style user:password arguments: -u user:[REDACTED] --user user:[REDACTED] (round 43).
-    re.compile(
-        r"(?i)((?<!\S)(?:-u|--user|--proxy-user|--login)(?:\s+|=)[\"']?[^\s:\"']+:)[^\s\"']+"
-    ),
+    # curl-style user:password arguments, attached or not, quoted or not:
+    # -u user:[REDACTED] -uuser:[REDACTED] --user [REDACTED] (rounds 43-44).
+    re.compile(r"(?i)((?<!\S)(?:-u|--user|--proxy-user|--login)(?:\s+|=)?)(\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*')"),
+    re.compile(r"(?i)((?<!\S)(?:-u|--user|--proxy-user|--login)(?:\s+|=)?[^\s:\"']+:)[^\s\"']+"),
     # Quoted JSON/YAML fields: {"password": "[REDACTED]"} (round 39).
     re.compile(
         r"(?i)(\"[a-z0-9_]*(?:token|secret|password|passwd|api[_-]?key|access[_-]?key|private[_-]?key|auth)[a-z0-9_]*\"\s*:\s*\")[^\"]{4,}"
     ),
     re.compile(r"\b(sk|ghp|gho|ghu|ghs|ghr|vcp|xox[abp]|npm_|pypi-|glpat-|AKIA)[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}"),
     re.compile(r"\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{5,}"),  # JWT
+    # Shape-agnostic last layer: any long token mixing letters and digits
+    # (API keys, encoded blobs, hashes). Topic keywords are words, so
+    # losing such tokens costs the evidence nothing (round 44).
+    re.compile(
+        r"(?<![\w/.-])(?=[A-Za-z0-9_+/=-]*\d)(?=[A-Za-z0-9_+/=-]*[A-Za-z])[A-Za-z0-9_+/=-]{20,}(?![\w/.-])"
+    ),
 )
